description: Crotti Gabriella and colleagues publish this resource through the source community. The XLSX collection supports the published evaluation of voltage-transformer accuracy in harmonic and interharmonic measurement. Coverage is the experiment associated with IEEE paper 10.1109/OJIM.2022.3198473. Its native description establishes the power-quality calibration role but does not specify the exact frequency grid, error variables, repetitions or observation dates. The workbook is one deposited measurement resource; the associated article is supporting documentation, not a second independent dataset. Zenodo supplies the deposited data and native file inventory with open access under cc-by-4.0. Sample values, linked files and code were not read or executed during source checks. A limitation is that complete implementation or measurement settings cannot be reconstructed from descriptive metadata alone. Related experimental components and publications retain their distinct roles; separate deposits are not assumed to provide independent observations.
